method: Production actual gun range, mechanical pitch and both pitched muzzle rays at zero/full recoil; Arc closest terminal, centre LOS and facing-side surface contact. Gun1-unit and Arc4-unit midpoint bins per species/complete route; Arc interval lengths are quadrature approximations; current player guard and independent sampled restrictions both apply; excluded combinations contribute no eligibility. This shared-preview gun probe covers base/upgrade1 only; active play-only gun tier2 and other play profile differences belong to campaign verification. Silo intervals are72/96/120 centre-range admission only; separate finite production flights establish selected examples. Base-useful means positive measured opportunity against both C species with at least one physically allowed base gun/Arc, not universal weapon fit or guaranteed damage. Adjacent alternatives are not a certified simultaneous arrangement.

excluded.reason: Complete yaw/pitch/recoil envelope can intersect a routed airborne body at the sampled pose.
